privacyPageIntro: This policy explains in plain language which data gsubs needs for transcripts, captions, exports, accounts, and credit purchases.
privacyCollectionBody: We process the video you select, its audio, generated captions, and export settings. If you create an account, we also store basic profile details and the status of your jobs. When you sign in with Google, these details may include the name, email address, and profile-image URL provided by Google. After account deletion, a cryptographic hash of the normalized email is retained for 365 days solely to prevent repeated signup credits.
privacyRetentionBody: All media files, captions, exports, and the project record are automatically deleted 24 hours after the last editing or export activity. Each new edit or export refreshes that window. You can also delete them immediately from History.
privacyPaymentsBody: GSUBS does not currently offer paid-credit purchases. If a separately reviewed release later activates them, payment would use Stripe-hosted Checkout; Stripe would process the buyer's name, email address, billing address, and payment details, while Ascentia would not receive or store the full card number or CVC. GSUBS would retain the minimum transaction and billing evidence needed for support, withdrawal handling, refunds, and accounting reconciliation.
privacyFinancialRetentionBody: No paid-credit sale is currently active. If financial records later exist after an approved activation, each Stripe payment would be manually matched to the tax document actually issued through AADE e-Timologio. Necessary payment and tax-document data, such as amount, VAT, Stripe references, document series and number, and MARK, would be retained through the end of the fifth full year after the relevant tax year and longer only when required by law or an active tax or payment dispute. A Stripe receipt would be payment evidence, not an AADE tax document. Account deletion would not erase records whose retention is legally required.
privacyProvidersBody: For transcription, audio may be sent to the service's active provider, currently ElevenLabs Scribe v2. Optional Intelligence features may use a separate AI provider only when you choose to run them. Paid-credit sales are not currently active; if they are approved later, Stripe would process payments and AADE e-Timologio would be used for tax documents actually issued.
privacyChoicesBody: From account settings, you can export your personal data, delete individual jobs, or permanently delete your account. You may also request access, correction, or another right provided by law, except for data Ascentia must retain for tax, accounting, or legal reasons.
privacyCookiesBody: We use strictly necessary cookies and browser storage for sign-in, language, cookie consent, and continuity of your current work.
privacyContactBody: For questions or requests about your data, contact Ascentia, the operator of gsubs, at info@ascentia-gp.com or through its official website.
termsPageIntro: These terms explain the basic rules for using gsubs. By using the service, you agree to use it lawfully and responsibly.
termsPaidCreditsDraftTitle: Proposed paid-credit terms — sales remain inactive
termsPaidCreditsDraftBody: GSUBS does not currently offer or sell paid credits online. The sections below are published as clearly inactive text for review and information, not as an operative offer for sale. Checkout will remain closed until the seller's exact legal identity, the terms, the durable confirmation medium, and the manual accounting workflow are approved.
termsAcceptanceBody: If you do not agree to these terms, do not upload content or use the service's processing features.
termsServiceBody: gsubs provides transcription, caption creation, preview, and video export tools. Features and availability may evolve as the product improves.
termsContentBody: You retain ownership of your content. You are responsible for having the necessary rights to every video, audio track, image, or text that you upload.
termsAccuracyBody: Transcripts, captions, and Intelligence results may contain errors. Review them before publication or use in decisions with significant consequences.
termsAvailabilityBody: We may need to limit or temporarily interrupt features for maintenance, security, or changes to external providers.
termsLiabilityBody: The service is provided in its currently available form, without a guarantee that every result will be error-free or suitable for every purpose.
termsPaidCreditsScopeBody: Online GSUBS credit purchases will be available only to consumers with a billing address in Greece. Each purchase will be one-off, with no subscription or automatic renewal, and the displayed final price will include 24% VAT. An eligible payment method will be temporarily authorized in Stripe-hosted Checkout. Capture and credit delivery will occur only after the Greek billing address and exact purchase evidence are validated from the signed Stripe event. If validation fails, the authorization will be canceled; the temporary hold may remain visible for a period determined by the payment method provider or issuer. The Stripe receipt will evidence payment, while the tax document will be issued manually through AADE e-Timologio and linked by series, sequential number, and MARK.
termsRefundsBody: There will be no automatic refunds or discretionary refunds merely because the user changed their mind or did not use the credits. This does not restrict any mandatory consumer right, including where applicable withdrawal, non-conforming performance, or a duplicate or unauthorized charge. Every request will be recorded and reviewed manually. If approved, the refund will be performed manually in Stripe and the tax adjustment document actually required by the accountant will be issued and recorded manually in AADE; submitting a request will not automatically perform any financial or tax action.
termsWithdrawalBody: A consumer may notify withdrawal within 14 days after the contract is concluded where the right applies. If the consumer expressly requested that the service begin before the period ends and part of the service has already been supplied, a proportionate amount may be due for the supplied part. The right is lost only after full performance and when the legal conditions have been met. Notice may be submitted from the account or to info@ascentia-gp.com and will receive an immutable receipt acknowledgement.
termsWithdrawalFormBody: To Ascentia / GSUBS, info@ascentia-gp.com: I give notice that I withdraw from my GSUBS credit-purchase contract. Purchase identifier: [purchase ID]. Consumer name: [name]. Consumer address: [address]. Date: [date]. Electronic submission from the account automatically fills the purchase identifier and records the receipt time.
